failure would redirect both approaches."},{"criterion":"open","value":5,"reason":"Names ensemble members per parameter point; published work stops at many independent sims with std devs; predicting real labels above that unmeasured, cheaply reachable."},{"criterion":"reshape","value":3,"reason":"Names event chain, GPU-idle realizations and decorrelation check, but the cited source already computes independent realizations in parallel for this system."}]}]}
